value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool A Learn to Swim Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3-5 without a parent in the water - their site says (Preschool B also runs 9:40-10:10am same dates). Fall registration opens Tuesday, Aug 11 at 7am for Oakville residents; you can browse options online starting Aug 4.
